ASSESSMENT PDF POLICY EXPERIMENTS
A readable policy notice changed the response
Research update / 7 October 2026
06 / 09
Luna pilot on one synthetic four-page assessment PDF
“I can’t answer or draft this assignment for you”
The response also referred the user to teaching staff.
Refusal persisted after these changes:
Re-rasterization
Render the pages as images again.
JPEG quality 95
Apply light image compression.
JPEG quality 85
Apply stronger image compression.
Resize and restore
Reduce to 75%, then restore the size.
Gaussian blur
Apply mild blur, radius 0.5 pixels.

Conclusions and next tests
Research update / 7 October 2026
09 / 09
The perturbation target remains unmet on Specification3 in the completed tests.
Readable notices and policy routing produced the target behaviour in the separate Luna pilot.
Different models and documents prevent a controlled ranking of these approaches.
